subject: Audit blockers, control ownership decisions, and regional scope clarifications
messages:
From: AuditPartner LLC <audits@auditpartner.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: scope clarifications & blockers for upcoming FedRAMP/ISO assessments

Hi Rishi / Kimberly,

Thanks for sharing the control mapping draft. As we scope the upcoming FedRAMP readiness review and the ISO 27001 surveillance, we've flagged a few items that will block auditor sample pulls unless we get decisions or evidence by May 20: 

1) Regional boundary: we need confirmation on whether the EU region handles snapshots and logging independently or if they fall into the US control plane for evidence collection (this affects sampling windows).
2) KMS attestation: the current KMS narrative references a third-party HSM — we need the attestation document and any rotation schedules for key material.
3) Enclave/on‑prem evidence path: some controls indicate artifacts stored in a customer-managed enclave. Confirm who will provide access and a contact for evidence pull (POC + read-only account).
4) Continuous monitoring logs: we identified gaps in 30-day retention for some streaming logs; if you plan to backfill, please share the retention policy and snapshot dates.

Please see the attached checklist for the items above (Attachment: scope_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)). If we can't close these by May 20 the FedRAMP dry-run will need to be scoped narrower or deferred.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick triage call tomorrow (30 min) to assign owners and agree deadlines
- Doc link for any supporting evidence you can upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AexampleScopeFolder

Let me know what times work.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Audit Lead, AuditPartner LLC
audits@auditpartner.com

--
Attachment: scope_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: AuditPartner LLC <audits@auditpartner.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: scope clarifications & blockers for upcoming FedRAMP/ISO assessments

Thanks Samir — good catch. Summary of actions from our side and quick answers inline below.

On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 09:14 AM AuditPartner LLC <audits@auditpartner.com> wrote:
> Hi Rishi / Kimberly,
> 
> Thanks for sharing the control mapping draft. As we scope the upcoming FedRAMP readiness review and the ISO 27001 surveillance, we've flagged a few items that will block auditor sample pulls unless we get decisions or evidence by May 20:
> ...

Responses / owners: 
- Regional boundary: CONFIRMED — EU production region keeps independent logging and snapshots for customer data. That means sampling will need localized pulls for EU tenants. Owner: Marissa Cole (CC'd).
- KMS attestation: We have an in-progress attestation from our HSM partner; draft is attached (kms_narrative_draft.pdf). Final sign-off expected by May 18. Owner: Kimberly Park.
- Enclave evidence path: For the customer-managed enclave, we'll provide a read-only collector account and a short runbook for auditors. Owner: Grace O'Connor.
- Log retention gaps: We're scheduling a 48‑hour backfill for the 30‑day window where possible and will document the snapshot times. Owner: Infra Ops (I'll loop them into the Drive folder).

Proposed schedule:
- Triage call: Wed 2027-05-12 10:00 AM PT (30 min) — does that work for AuditPartner?
- Evidence upload: we'll start populating the Drive folder today; target to have KMS draft and enclave runbook by EOD 2027-05-18.

Attachments: scope_matrix_v2.xlsx, kms_narrative_draft.pdf

Quick ask for you, Samir: for FedRAMP specifically, can you confirm the auditor expectations around split-region sampling? Are they accepting exported snapshots in place of in‑region access for this dry‑run? If not, we need to escalate capacity for localized pulls.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

--
Attachments: scope_matrix_v2.xlsx, kms_narrative_draft.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, AuditPartner LLC <audits@auditpartner.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: scope clarifications & blockers for upcoming FedRAMP/ISO assessments

Thanks Rishi and Samir — quick notes from ops/security: 

- KMS attestation: I own delivery. The HSM partner provided a compliance packet this morning; I'll upload the attestation and rotation schedule to the Drive folder by EOD (file: kms_attestation_final.pdf). Expect formal sign-off on 2027-05-18.
- EU snapshots: We can provide exported snapshots for the dry-run but auditors generally prefer in‑region access. If AuditPartner insists on in‑region pulls we will need a short-term observer account — request that to be provisioned during the triage call.
- Enclave access: Grace will coordinate a read-only collector and a minimal SOP. Note: for any customer-managed enclaves that are air-gapped we will require the customer to ferry artifacts; I'll flag these in the scope matrix.

I'll be on the call Wednesday.

Kimberly Park
Head, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

--
Attachment planned: kms_attestation_final.pdf (to be uploaded)
From: AuditPartner LLC <audits@auditpartner.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: scope clarifications & blockers for upcoming FedRAMP/ISO assessments

All — thanks for the quick updates. Wed 10:00 AM PT works for us. Two quick clarifications ahead of the call: 

1) Split-region approach: For the dry-run we're willing to accept exported snapshots if accompanied by audit-friendly transfer logs and a chain-of-custody note. For the formal FedRAMP assessment we will need in‑region observer access (we'll document exactly what level of access).
2) Evidence packaging: please upload KMS attestation + rotation schedule and the enclave SOP before the call; if the files are not present we'll push the dry-run sample window back.

I created a shared DocuSign envelope for a temporary observer NDA we use for in-region observer accounts: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/example-sign. If you can have the relevant approver (legal or compliance) sign the NDA we can provision sooner.

See you on the call.

Samir Patel
Audit Lead, AuditPartner LLC
audits@auditpartner.com

--
